ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, which is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a food web, and the group of organisms at the bottom is labeled “primary producers (plants)”. Above there are also labels such as “detritivores”, “carnivores”, “predatory invertebrates”, “sucking insects”, and they are connected with arrows. Reasoning: The question asks which one is the producer in the food web. The picture clearly labels “primary producers” as “plants”, therefore the producers are plants.
